notes: Log food in cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, fl oz, oz or lb, with one-tap fractions (¼, ⅓, ½, ⅔, ¾, 1½).
Label in grams but you used a spoon? Add what the serving "also equals" (like 2 tbsp) and log in either. Scanning a label fills this in when the label shows both.
The app converts between cups, spoons, ml and fl oz, and between g, oz and lb.
